lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 004: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: Fixed the reviewer-flagged stale/overclaiming prose in the patterns.md bullet at (then) line 1128, the US-R1-001 (CAM-474 round 1) writeup of isCommandPosition. That bullet's closing sentence asserted, unqualified, that 'isCommandPosition's char-adjacency check catches the $(-prefixed real invocation while still rejecting the four false-positive shapes above' -- a capability claim that was measurably false when checked against the code as it stood right after ONLY that round-1 fix: `bash -c 'grep -rl zzqqx scripts'` and `bash -c 'test -n "$(grep -rl zzqqx scripts)"'` both returned null (no finding), because command-position recognition of the tool word alone was not sufficient -- the space-free $(...) form's root token was still corrupted by an un-stripped trailing ')' until US-R2-001 added stripTrailingShellPunctuation, and the bash -c-wrapped form was not recognized as command position at all until US-R2-002 added the quote-adjacency case (isShellDashCQuoteOpen). Both of those fixes are separate, already-shipped stories in this same PRD (committed before this one); this story touched ONLY the prose describing the round-1 state, not any source file. Verified empirically before and is captured in the corrected bullet text: measured against CURRENT HEAD (post-US-R2-002), both example commands now DO correctly resolve to a 'scripts' root -- the underlying detector is correct today, only the round-1 bullet's narration of its OWN capabilities at that point in the fix sequence was inaccurate. Replaced the false unqualified claim with an accurate boundary statement: what round-1's isCommandPosition alone caught (command position of the tool word after a bare '$('), what it did NOT yet make correct end-to-end (both wrapper forms, for two independent reasons), which follow-on round-2 fixes closed each gap, and an explicit note that the fix is verified against current HEAD. No source file was touched -- this was a patterns.md-only correction, per the 'a comment/doc does not prove behavior, verify the runtime' project lesson. check:all is fully green: typecheck ok, test 5873/5873 (identical count to the prior handoff, since no test file changed), lint ok, file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet all ok, embed-vendor n/a (patterns.md is not under vendor/templates). No pattern-records.jsonl file exists in this repo, so appliedPatternIds is omitted. No new patterns.md bullet added beyond the correction itself -- this story IS the correction to an existing bullet, not a new discovery warranting its own separate bullet.
